I think you (Daniel) are wrong about gcc 4.2.1.  I have never installed another c++ compilers but xcode.  Xcode worked for me for stan and rstan.  

But for Xcode 5, it does not matter now. According to here (http://apple.stackexchange.com/questions/102863/where-to-find-arm-gcc-compiler-in-xcode5), gcc(g++) in Xcode 5 is actually clang(clang++).  And I do have the same (error) output from gcc and clang now.  So essentially the problem is a clang++ problem.  And I failed to build bin/stanc (or rstan) 1.3.0 using Xcode 5.  So I am afraid that Mac users who upgraded to Xcode 5 are not able to install stan/rstan 1.3.0. 

--
Jiqiang
